data.narrative:
Notus Autonomous Systems is a Seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Emmanuel Margolin and Arhum Jain. The company has raised $500K to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI—spanning Seed and Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $500K raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $1.25M. Peer-median analysis examined three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A). The median valuation across this cohort is $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $1M to $460M, with a median of $201M. The extreme width of this range reflects material uncertainty in Stage-progression valuation given Notus's nascent capital structure, and potential valuation dispersion within the Defense & Security peer set itself. The median estimate is driven primarily by peer comparables; however, confirmation through additional methods or closer stage-alignment among peers would strengthen conviction in any point valuation within this band.
